description: The stored probation (7 February) is the one these penalties produce: 5 + 4 + 1 = 10, and the second 1 PP that evening reaches 11. It is not also used as a seed, so the earlier 1 PP that day is not doubled; the result is 0 PP with probation from 7 February.
rule_ref: penalties.ts probationSeed (a probation the replay re-derives is not seeded again)
